title: Pure Cyber Girl
summary: Cyber Girl is Alexis Rhodes' original EARTH Warrior athletic dancer archetype from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX, led by Etoile Cyber, Blade Skater, Cyber Prima, Cyber Tutu, and the Fusion boss Cyber Blader. Modern support like Cyber Tutubon and Cyber Egg Angel unites the EARTH Warriors to Fusion Summon Cyber Blader and lock down opposing board effects.

allow.Fusion Deployment: Reveals Cyber Blader in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater directly from the Deck.
allow.Fusion Conscription: Reveals Cyber Blader in the Extra Deck to add Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater from Deck or GY to the hand.
allow.Polymerization: Essential Fusion Spell searchable via Cyber Egg Angel and recycled via Cyber Tutubon to summon Cyber Blader.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Etoile Cyber, Blade Skater, Cyber Tutu, or Cyber Gymnast.
allow.Cross-Sheep: Link-2 monster that triggers a draw and discard when Cyber Blader is Fusion Summoned to its arrow.

main: Etoile Cyber
Essential Fusion Material for Cyber Blader that gains 500 ATK when attacking the opponent directly.
Blade Skater
Essential Fusion Material for Cyber Blader with 1400 ATK / 1500 DEF EARTH Warrior stats.
Cyber Tutubon
Level 5 EARTH Warrior Cyber Girl that Special Summons itself from the hand by Tributing a Warrior or Fairy, and recovers a Ritual Spell if Tributed.
Cyber Tutu
Can attack the opponent directly if every monster the opponent controls has higher ATK than Cyber Tutu.
Cyber Gymnast
Discards 1 card once per turn to destroy 1 face-up Attack Position monster the opponent controls.
Cyber Prima
Level 6 LIGHT Warrior Cyber Girl that destroys all face-up Spell Cards on the field when Tribute Summoned.
Cyber Egg Angel
Searches Ritual Sanctuary or supports the Alexis engine alongside Fusion Deployment.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Cyber Blader to Special Summon Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater directly from the Deck.
Fusion Conscription
Reveals Cyber Blader to search the missing Fusion Material (Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater) from the Deck.
Polymerization
Fuses Etoile Cyber and Blade Skater into Cyber Blader.
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches Etoile Cyber, Blade Skater, or Cyber Gymnast.
extra: Signature Level 7 Warrior Fusion boss: cannot be destroyed by battle (if opponent controls 1 monster), doubles its ATK to 4200 (if 2 monsters), or negates ALL opponent's monster, Spell, and Trap effects (if 3 monsters).
Link-2 monster that triggers off Cyber Blader's Fusion Summon.
